note: National name table of PLATE names (the remembered name of an area: at most 12 characters and 2 words). Blocks are frozen at first issue (20 October 2026), sized on the compounds actually grouped: a block is never renumbered; a new area with an existing name gets the next block from that name's spare space. Built from the OSM places of model/keys.json. aliases: normalised official name -> normalised plate name, where the official name maps to one plate name; aliasesDropped: official names that would be claimed by two plate names (or are another plate name), so they do not decode.

rules.digits: 4 if blocks + 500 <= 9000, else 5 if blocks + 5000 <= 90000, else qualifier
